lee: Scheduling a targeted cross-region failover drill for ap-southeast-1 on Fri 03:00 UTC. Window 25m. Objective: exercise routing failover, verify warm-standby capacity, and confirm SLO tagging. No customer-impact expected, but brief 5xx tail possible.

harper: Noted. Which components are being failed over?

lee: Plan: take inference-worker subset (canary-group) in ap-southeast-1 out of rotation and simulate region egress failure. Control-plane stays writable. We'll route traffic to us-west-2 warm-standby.

anya: I'll update the runbook and add muted alert rules for the window. Please share exact abort thresholds.

sre-bot: maintenance created: maint-1785123456 | start: 2026-05-09T03:00:00Z | duration: 25m | owner: lee

mike: Loadgen profile: ramp 0->250 TPS in 4m, hold 17m, ramp down. Mix 65% text-gen, 25% chat, 10% embeddings. Tag run with crossfail/1785123456.

lee: Abort if any of:
- 5m error rate on inference > 2.5%
- p95 latency increase > 350ms above baseline for >5m
- streaming disconnect rate > 1.5% for >3m
If abort, rollback by re-enabling ap-southeast-1 subset and failback routing.

harper: Can we get the literal alert queries?

lee: Copied (promql):
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[5m])) > 0.025
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le)) > (baseline_p95 + 0.35)

anya: Preflight checklist: run `rjctl standby-health --region=us-west-2` and `scripts/region_precheck.sh ap-southeast-1`. I'll run nightly until the drill.

ops-comm: I'll send customer opt-in banner and update status page with "resilience exercise" copy and contact link.

sre-bot: reminder: maint-1785123456 starts in 24h

tara: For observability, please tag metrics with `maintenance:crossfail_ap1` and add a brief SLO note. Post-run we should run a 1h post-check to confirm no residual error-rate drift.

mike: Will post loadgen traces and request IDs after the run.

harper: I'll prepare mute rules scoped to `inference.5xx.alert` and `stream.disconnects` for the window; keep paging enabled for control-plane write errors.

lee: Operator run steps: 1) preflight checks 2) enable failover: `rjctl zone-drain --region=ap-southeast-1 --subset=canary --dry-run=false --reason="cross-region-drill"` 3) monitor dashboards + alerts 4) if abort -> `rjctl zone-rollback --region=ap-southeast-1`

anya: Assigned: runbook + muted alerts (EOD), prechecks (sam nightly), loadgen (mike), comms (ops-comm).

lee: Thanks all. If prechecks flag anything, postpone and rebook. Otherwise proceed as scheduled. :white_check_mark:
